messages:
Maya: Heads-up — bringing up OrionX-14b in staging (GGML fork). Need a concise perf + quant + quality playbook so we can gate rollout. Target: low-latency chat path. Can we draft a smoke checklist and owners?

Alex: I can own perf sweeps. Proposal for prioritized matrix: ctx lengths = [512, 1024, 2048, 4096], batch sizes = [1,2,4,8], warmup vs cold behavior. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, GPU mem. Clarify latency SLOs?

Maya: Latency SLOs: p50 <= 150ms for batch=1 and ctx<=1024; p95 <= 350ms. Throughput goal: ~1200 tok/s per GPU at 2048 if achievable. Quant targets: try int8 first, then int4 (AWQ) if quality holds.

Chris: For quant experiments I'll run q8_0 and AWQ variants. Checklist additions: compile with both triton and torchscript backends, log kernel selection, check fallback behavior when sequence > profile. Also note memory/residency and offload if needed.

Zara: QA will run three eval suites: safety, instruction-following, hallucination probes. Baseline comparisons against Lyra-9b (current prod). Thresholds: instruction F1 delta <= 2% and safety pass-rate >= 95%. If we see regressions, tag examples and block rollout.

Alex: Perf smoke command I'll run locally and in CI:
```
# perf smoke command
python perf/run_infer.py --model orionx-14b --device cuda --batch 1,2,4 --ctx 512,1024,2048 --iters 200 --profile --save-metrics ./tmp/orionx_pf.json
```
Collect: tokens/s, p50/p95 latency, GPU util, mem usage, kernel names, compile logs.

Chris: Warmup strategy: ping with canonical prompts to populate KV cache and JIT kernels. Sequence:
1) cold load
2) 10 warmup requests (batch=1, ctx=256)
3) measure p50 baseline
Also add a lambda to test multi-user concurrency (2x,4x).

perf-bot: Perf job queued: job_id=pf-3801-orionx, estimated runtime ~3h. CI link: https://ci.redwood/pf-3801 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya: Quant experiment order proposal: 1) Q8 (q8_0) smoke -> 2) Q4 dynamic -> 3) AWQ int4. Run full eval/harness after each step. Revert if instruction F1 drop > 3% or safety fails.

Alex: Add batching profile step: sweep batch sizes and find elbow where p95 latency increases >20% or tokens/s plateaus. That batch size is our recommended production max for that ctx.

Zara: I'll prepare eval harness and dataset slices today, ETA EOD tomorrow. Will include automated diff reports and sample failing prompts for triage.

Chris: @Alex @Maya infra note — we need one extra g5x2 node for the 4k context runs; can someone submit provisioning?

Alex: I'll open infra ticket and coordinate.

Maya: Owners: Alex (perf), Chris (quant/infra), Zara (eval/QA). Tracking in tracker RH-1428. Reconvene after perf-bot completes and we have initial metrics. Thanks everyone :rocket:
